cards.heading: Power architecture
cards.description: Are rails, sequencing, and brown-out behaviour defined for worst-case load and input conditions — not just the bench supply?

cards.heading: Component selection & lifecycle
cards.description: Are critical parts second-sourced or on long-term availability, with no single-source or end-of-life components hiding in the BOM?

cards.heading: Thermal design
cards.description: Has thermal performance been validated at maximum ambient and full load, inside the final enclosure rather than on an open bench?

cards.heading: Firmware & hardware interaction
cards.description: Are shared buses, interrupts, memory access, and startup sequencing reviewed across the complete system?

cards.heading: EMC & signal integrity
cards.description: Do stack-up, return paths, interface timing, and emissions risks have a plan before certification testing?

cards.heading: Protection & fault handling
cards.description: Are overload, over-temperature, reverse polarity, and recovery paths designed and validated?

cards.heading: Design for manufacturing
cards.description: Has the layout been reviewed for assembly, sourcing, yield, and production test access?

cards.heading: Test & programming access
cards.description: Are test points, fixtures, programming, and end-of-line verification planned for the manufacturing process?

cards.heading: Field update & recovery
cards.description: Can every unit in the field receive a secure update and recover from an interrupted or failed deployment?

cards.heading: Enclosure & environmental
cards.description: Have ingress, vibration, temperature, and service conditions been validated in the final enclosure?
